conviction_note: Findings sum to +0.3 (a conservative implied Q4 and activist-driven capital-return pressure, offset by a cautious FY27 first guide into a weak Denver housing tape); scaled number is (2*0.52-1)*3.0 = +0.12 because every finding is inside the company's guide or a proxy, the name's reactions are small (median 1.93%), and there is no option market to tell us where positioning sits.
bar: Company FY2026 guide: EPS $0.43-$0.52 (Quartr Q3 summary, https://quartr.com/events/pure-cycle-corporation-pcyo-q3-2026_3PCxaNgm, 2026-07-09); one Q3-call summary has management saying EPS 'around $0.50' with upside depending on Q4. Revenue guide is disputed between $28-32M (Quartr) and $26-30M (other summaries). Nine-month EPS $0.36 and revenue ~$22.5M, so implied Q4 is EPS $0.07-$0.16, revenue ~$5.5-9.5M. No sell-side consensus found (TipRanks 0 analysts, FXEmpire blank). print_vs_bar_pct is measured against the EPS guide midpoint $0.475 (an expected ~$0.49). EPS bar is company-sourced; revenue bar disputed, so revenue-dependent sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest ~486.7K shares, ~2.0% of float, 6.1 days to cover, data through early Oct 2026 (Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/pcyo/summary); Aug reading 428.5K / 1.78% / 8.2 days. Not crowded, but days to cover is elevated because turnover is thin (76.6K shares/day, ~$0.8M). No usable option chain (ATM legs not two-sided, total OI 239, put/call OI 1.3), so no skew. Holder base: Maran Capital 14.7% (activist, nominated 5 directors on 2026-08-07), Magnolia 7.5% (13G/A 2026-08-14). Baseline run-up: +1.14% over 20 days, -2.29% over 5 days, 10.6% below 52w high.

findings.finding: The FY26 EPS guide of $0.43-$0.52 implies a fiscal Q4 of only $0.07-$0.16 after nine-month EPS of $0.36. Q4 is normally the company's biggest quarter: Q4 FY25 was $0.25 on $11.2M revenue, and Q4 FY24 was $0.27. Management said EPS would be 'around $0.50' with upside depending on Q4. Against that, management also said the mild winter pulled lot deliveries forward and should even out by year end, and Phase 2D was 84% complete at May 31. So the expected print is near the top of the guide, inside it, not above it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior full-year print (2025-11-13, Q4 EPS $0.25 against $0.27 a year earlier, attributed to lot-sale timing) moved -1.6%. The last six prints ranged -4.55% to +4.78%, median abs 1.93%, 3 up and 3 down. The name does not pay much for the reported quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst publishes a number, so the only bar is the wide company range. If the market expected a Q4 like the last two, the stock would have rerated toward the 52w high after the July call; it sits 10.6% below it, with a flat 20d run-up. The offset (deliveries pulled forward) is the company's own statement, which is why this is sized near zero rather than as a beat.
findings.independence: Q4 FY25 comparison from the company's FY25 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465925111010/pcyo-20251112xex99d2.htm, 2025-11-12). The guide range, and management's 'around $0.50, upside on Q4' remark, come from the Q3 call summary on the same call, carried by https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/pure-cycle-q3-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-09/ (snippet only, 403 on fetch). Both rest on one call.

findings.finding: Water and wastewater revenue rose 119% and 34% in fiscal Q3 on oil and gas operators' water demand, and oil and gas royalty income 'rose sharply' in FY25. That supports the Q4 water line even if lot revenue is lighter. It is inside the guide, which was reiterated knowing this demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history of a water-line surprise. Q4 FY25's higher tap and royalty income offset weaker lot timing and the stock still fell 1.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: O&G water sales are lumpy and not modelled by anyone. If the market were pricing a continuation, the stock would not be flat on 20 days. Colorado's rig count fell to 12 (Oct 2026), so continuation is not assured, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Same Q3 call as finding 1, so one document read twice. Weakly contradicted by Colorado's rig count of 12 as of 2026-10-10 (https://www.oilpriceapi.com/data/rig-count/state/colorado), a state-level proxy.

findings.finding: This release is the likely first FY2027 guide. On the Q1 call the CEO said FY27 would look like the past few years, not a breakout year, and that $0.75/share might be too high. The Q2 summary said FY27 guidance would come once Phase 2E and O&G visibility improved. Since then Denver housing has weakened: September 2026 metro closed sales fell 21.4% y/y to the lowest September since 2008 (DMAR via ColoradoBiz, 2026-10-05), and Zonda put Q2 2026 Denver new-home closings at -17% y/y with the median new-home price down ~10%. Management already flagged 'moderate new-home demand through 2026'. The risk is a FY27 guide at the low end of the 200-350 lots/year cadence.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-11-13 full-year print, which carried the FY26 guide of $0.43-$0.52 (below FY25's $0.54), moved -1.6%. The 2026-01-08 Q1 print, where the CEO played down FY27, moved +4.78%, so a guide does not mechanically sell this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Thin coverage and no option market, so nothing prices the guide. If a weak FY27 were priced, the stock would sit nearer its 52w low (it is 8.4% above it). The housing series is a resale/metro proxy: builders at Sky Ranch buy finished lots on contract and seven builders are active, so the transmission is not confirmed by the company, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Zonda Denver Q2 2026 new-home closings -17% y/y (https://www.builderonline.com/?p=177488, via search snippet). Management's own 'moderate demand' risk and the CEO's FY27 remarks: https://quartr.com/events/pure-cycle-corporation-pcyo-q3-2026_3PCxaNgm and https://finance.yahoo.com/news/pure-cycle-q1-earnings-call-153959237.html.

findings.finding: An activist holds 14.7% (Maran Capital, 13D/A 2026-08-06) and on 2026-08-07 nominated five directors for the 2027 annual meeting. The board added two directors on 2026-08-25 and has a strategy and capital-allocation committee led by Maran's principal. At the July Investor Day management said it would increase buybacks over the next 12-18 months, would consider dividends, and put sum-of-the-parts value at ~$800M against a ~$250M market cap. Under a live proxy contest, the year-end release and call are the natural place to announce an accelerated buyback, a dividend or a committee outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior capital-return announcement at a print in the baseline window. The 2026-01-08 print (+4.78%) came a week before the Maran cooperation agreement and director appointment.
findings.why_not_priced: The contest is public, but nothing dates an announcement, and the stock has done nothing since August (20d +1.1%). If a buyback acceleration were expected at this print, the 5-day drift into it would not be -2.3%. It may not come at all, hence the wide band skewed up.
findings.independence: Investor Day buyback and dividend language: https://quartr.com/events/pure-cycle-corporation-pcyo-investor-day-2026-q-a_3PCxaCmV (2026-07-21). Board additions and 13D/A from https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/PCYO/. Different documents, same mechanism, merged into one finding.
